intro.text: A bank official who holds records Marasi and Wayne need for an investigation.

items.text: Marasi and Wayne came asking for the ledgers of some graveyard workers. Despite Marasi's identification, Eriola stalled until Constable-General Reddi confirmed the inquiry; meanwhile Wayne built a tower from the things on his desk and replaced his letter opener with an extremely long rat's tail. The ledgers revealed that the workers were robbing corpses, which shocked Eriola.
Afterwards Marasi told Wayne that people like Eriola answer best to authority, and Wayne grudgingly conceded the point.

appearance.text: Short, portly and dark-skinned; Wayne thinks his belly and head are shaped like cannonballs and suspects he is part dolphin.

personality.text: Skeptical by nature and protective of his clients' privacy, he was at first plainly put out by Marasi's visit.
